title: Locate exact 25 Bidang Amanah source and mission mapping
baseline_note: The task names branch dev HEAD 659da28; that commit is the ledger baseline and is an ancestor of the observed final worktree HEAD e76df8b. Another session advanced dev during this task (M26-02 and M31-03 closures); the quoted TODO.md lines are unchanged and all locators still resolve at e76df8b. Unrelated uncommitted changes from another session were present under apps/cockpit, apps/dock, apps/headquarters and docs/audit/screens and were not touched.
acceptance: 25 evidence rows or explicitly unverified, never guessed names
scope_note: This ledger records locators, candidate classification and absence. It does not recover, invent, authenticate or canonicalize any of the 25 field names or any mission mapping.

status_definitions.EVIDENCED: A repository locator enumerates this exact field name inside a complete ordered list of all 25 fields. No slot and no candidate qualifies at this baseline.
status_definitions.PARTIAL_REFERENCE: A cited repository line names the 25-field model, its declared count, or a related proposal/registry/plan, but enumerates none of the 25 field names. Used for candidate sources, never to promote a slot.
status_definitions.NEEDS_SOURCE: The repository declares a 25-field model and count, but no locator names, sequences, defines or maps this individual slot. Every slot is NEEDS_SOURCE; external candidates that are only named as targets to locate are also NEEDS_SOURCE.
status_definitions.NOT_FOUND: Examined in-repo locators establish that the exact list, the mission mapping, or a related artifact is absent from the repository. No candidate source exists in-repo.

no_guessed_names.rule: A slot name is permitted only when name_locator resolves to a cited file:line whose text contains that exact name. Asserting a complete 25-name list additionally requires enumerated_source.kind=EXACT_ENUMERATION with 25 verified entries. This ledger asserts neither.

assertions: The repository contains no enumerated list of the 25 Bidang Amanah fields. MASTER_VISION_NARRATIVE_XV.md:919 states that the exact final list, associated Qur'an references and a previously mentioned cosmic Asma-engine design were not retrieved as verified repository files, and forbids manufacturing 25 names.

All 25 ledger slots are NEEDS_SOURCE: the number 25 is declared, but no in-repo line names, sequences, defines or maps any individual field. Zero slots are EVIDENCED and zero field names are asserted.

The closest in-repo 25-item proposal is the 25 Prophetic Mission Avatars, recorded in M11 as PROPOSAL_ONLY_NOT_INTEGRATED with namesRecovered false and seededNames 0. It is related but is not evidence for the 25 Bidang Amanah fields.
The M11 Prophetic Mission Table stores six source-cited mission claims for five figures. None is mapped to a Bidang Amanah slot, and no mapping table or field relation exists in the repository.

BLUEPRINT.md:227 records the roster as unverified; docs/planning/DOMAIN_COVERAGE.md:4 records the originals and rights as UNKNOWN; MASTER_VISION_NARRATIVE_XV.md:1124 calls for authorized source retrieval and a 25-row reviewed matrix.
AMANAH also appears as one Empire/UNILEX label (AMANAH Access; a Qur'anic concept gloss). It is a label collision, not one of the 25 fields, and grants no authority.
No external repository, archive, chat log or credentialed source was fetched. XII mission registries and authorized originals are recorded as NEEDS_SOURCE, not as absent externally.
Ledger-local ids amanah-slot-01 through amanah-slot-25 are row identifiers, not field names, source titles or canonical sequence numbers.

candidates.contribution: Names the 25 Bidang Amanah model and its conceptual chain (Qur'an/Divine Ontology to Amanah to prophetic mission to avatar to agent to shadow to tasks).
candidates.notes: Lists zero fields, zero Qur'an references and zero mission assignments. It describes the model's intended relations, not its contents.

candidates.contribution: Declares the 25-field model a high-priority archival/source-recovery item, requires every unsupported role to be marked NEEDS_SOURCE, and directs comparison against XII mission registries.
candidates.notes: A recovery plan and an explicit no-manufacture rule. It is not a source table and contains no field names.

candidates.contribution: Confirms that 25 Amanah is a declared taxonomy and that its roster and originals remain unverified/UNKNOWN.
candidates.notes: Count-only authority statement. It neither enumerates nor orders the fields.

candidates.contribution: Records the closest in-repo 25-item proposal, the 25 Prophetic Mission Avatars, as PROPOSAL_ONLY_NOT_INTEGRATED with 0 recovered and 0 seeded names.
candidates.notes: Related concept only. The M11 policy itself states its final list was not recovered; it is not evidence for the 25 Bidang Amanah fields.

candidates.contribution: Confirms a real repository mission registry exists: 5 figures and 6 source-cited missions in the M11 Prophetic Mission Table.
candidates.notes: The registry has no Amanah field, no 25-slot foreign key and no mapping table. It cannot supply the missing mission-to-field mapping.

candidates.contribution: Establishes the central negative finding: the exact final 25-field list was not retrieved as a verified repository file, and the vision marks the model absent.
candidates.notes: No in-repo or cited external location contains an enumerated 25-row list. Absence is recorded as absence.

candidates.contribution: Establishes that the exact final 25 Amanah mission mapping is an open evidence task and that no 25-row reviewed matrix exists.
candidates.notes: The six M11 missions are not assigned to any of the 25 slots. A mission registry existing is not a mapping.

candidates.contribution: Records that AMANAH also labels one Empire system, one UNILEX concept and a scoped-responsibility definition.
candidates.notes: A same-word label is not a 25-field entry. The Empire row carries no authority and the concept is a single term, so none supplies a field name.

candidates.contribution: Records that a previously mentioned cosmic Asma-engine design is also missing from verified repository files.
candidates.notes: Mentioned only so it is not silently merged into the 25-field model. No design document, schema or name list exists in-repo.

candidates.contribution: Records the XII mission registries named as a comparison target for the recovery work.
candidates.notes: Not present in this repository and not fetched. Recorded as NEEDS_SOURCE, not as absent externally and not as evidence.

candidates.contribution: Records the authorized original source(s) that the vision says must be located before editorial review.
candidates.notes: No archive, chat log, manuscript or credentialed source was opened. Its identity, rights and location are unknown in this repository.

candidates.contribution: Records that the vision explicitly does not ratify creation of 25 agents by writing the narrative.
candidates.notes: A prohibition, not an inventory. The line's '25 agents' is a plan constraint, not the 25 Bidang Amanah roster, and it reinforces that the 25 must not be manufactured from prose.

mission_mapping.note: Six source-cited missions exist in the M11 Prophetic Mission Table, but no repository table, field, foreign key or document maps any mission to a Bidang Amanah field. The 25-avatar proposal recovered zero names, so it cannot supply a mapping either.

limitations: Read-only repository research at 659da28. No external repository, archive, chat log, database or credentialed source was fetched.
Absence in this repository is not proof of non-existence externally. The XII mission registries and authorized originals remain NEEDS_SOURCE.
Git history was searched for the exact phrases but no historical enumerated list was found; this does not prove an uncommitted or out-of-repository list never existed.
The M11 mission titles are quoted from source-cited seed data, not adopted as canonical field names or as the missing mapping.
Unrelated uncommitted worktree changes from another session were not inspected beyond git status and were not modified.
